input.summary: Make the cap the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, and carve out confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap set at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, so we have replaced the narrow "amount paid for the transaction to which the liability relates" basis. We have also placed breach of confidentiality (Section 10), gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud outside the cap alongside the existing Section 8 indemnity carve-out.

ops.oldText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OR SECTION 10 OF THIS AGREEMENT, OR ARISING OUT OF A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL AMOUNT PAID OR PAYABLE BY CORIO HEREUNDER DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE LIABILITY AND (B) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (US $1,000,000).
